integrity: The main decomposition and two-crown/four-crown examples are credited to Fornaroli–Khrypchenko; they are not claimed as new. Priority against all terminology and unpublished sources remains open. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field linear skew derivations of crown incidence algebras for m>=3, not arbitrary posets, semilinear maps or the two-crown. Cohomology quotient dimensions are proved by an established literature isomorphism and explicit rank calculations. Finite checks do not replace proof.
title: Complete skew-derivation cohomology spectrum for finite crown incidence algebras
